Method of Attack: Information stealing Trojan that steals browser cookies and stored credentials
Monitors Windows clipboard for certain text and modifies it to attacker-controlled strings
Hijacks cryptocurrency payments and Steam trades by replacing legitimate payment addresses and URLs with attacker-controlled ones
Steals bitcoin wallets, stored passwords, documents from desktop, and screenshots of active windows
Uploads stolen data to attacker-controlled web panel
Impacted Systems: Browsers including Chrome, Yandex, Orbitum, Opera, Amigo, Torch, Comodo
Attack Vector: Stealing files and credentials from victim's desktop and browsers
Indicators of Compromise: Replacement of cryptocurrency addresses in clipboard (Bitcoin, Litecoin, Monero, WebMoney, Qiwi)
Stolen wallet.dat file from Bitcoin registry key location
Uploaded zip file containing stolen data and screenshots to attacker web panel
